purpose: Close five shortest current mechanics footprints using bounded current Xenoverse 2 evidence.

targets.name: Rolling Hercule Punch
targets.boundary: Source-reported damage and timing are not treated as patch-independent; no hidden gate, reward probability, frame data, or universal balance value inferred.

targets.name: Saturday Crash
targets.boundary: Historical patch discussion is preserved as version context; no exact frame timing, hidden gate, reward probability, or patch-independent damage value inferred.

targets.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack
targets.boundary: The 4-second trigger and damage are source-reported mechanics, not independently benchmarked; no hidden gate, probability, or frame data inferred.

targets.name: Super Ghost Kamikaze Attack (Ultimate)
targets.boundary: Damage values are source-reported and version-sensitive; no exact frame data, reward probability, hidden gate, or universal damage claim inferred.

targets.name: Supernova Cooler
targets.boundary: Damage and startup comparisons are source-reported; no exact frame data, hidden gate, reward probability, or patch-independent damage claim inferred.

result: Five 78-character mechanics placeholders were replaced with bounded mechanics descriptions. Acquisition identities, relationship endpoints, and unresolved reward semantics were preserved.
